title: Synthetic processing-method benchmark
summary: Demonstration data for report authoring; no real measurements or method improvement are claimed.

questions.text: Which method warrants an independent comparison?

evidence.title: Synthetic benchmark summaries
evidence.description: Illustrative baseline mean 124 ms across 30 trials on device A; candidate mean 118 ms across eight trials on device B. Variability is unavailable.

findings.title: Observed difference needs a controlled evaluation
findings.statement: The supplied means differ, but the device and method change together.
limitations: The comparison does not isolate the method effect.
next_steps: Freeze both methods and evaluate on comparable devices and new trials.

figures.title: Reported means
figures.caption: Mean elapsed time in milliseconds, with trial counts and device labels.
figures.reading_guide: A shorter bar is a lower reported mean, not a validated causal improvement.

analysis.method: Descriptive comparison of synthetic supplied summaries

limitations: All values are synthetic demonstration data.
No trial-level observations or variability estimates are supplied.
